review.notes:
Version 1.1 is a substantial rework after the 4.3 / 4.2.6 rejection of 1.0. It is no longer a price list: it is a personal savings tool built around the user's own contract.

WHAT IS NEW IN 1.1
- The user saves the contract they have today (picked from the official ANRE list or typed from the bill) and the app calculates the yearly saving of every offer in their area against it.
- Offer detail: the price broken down into energy, distribution, transport, taxes and VAT (chart), which part differs between suppliers and which is regulated, the estimated bill month by month (seasonal gas profile), contract terms, the official offer PDF and the steps to switch supplier.
- Daily price history of the cheapest offer in the user's distribution zone / locality, charted against their contract.
- Local background alerts (BGAppRefreshTask + local notifications) when a new offer costs less than the saved contract. Calculated on device; nothing is sent anywhere.
- Several saved homes, each with its own postal code, consumption and contracts.

HOW TO TEST
Tab Economii: enter a Romanian postal code (060042 Bucharest, 400001 Cluj-Napoca, 700259 Iasi). Tap "Adaugă" next to Curent and either pick an offer or type a price such as 1,45 - the yearly saving appears at the top and on every offer. Tap any offer for the detail screen. Tab Istoric shows the price history; tab Locuințe adds homes and turns on alerts. No account or login.

ABOUT GUIDELINES 4.3 / 4.2.6
- Standalone app, conceived, designed, coded and published by me as an individual developer. It is not made for a client or third party and not built from a template, app builder or generation service.
- The binary shares no code, framework or assets with any other app on my account or with any third-party app; it uses only Apple frameworks (SwiftUI, Swift Charts, BackgroundTasks, UserNotifications).
- The content is public price data from the Romanian Energy Regulatory Authority's official comparator (posf.ro), collected and processed daily by my own open pipeline (github.com/puiutpavel-dot/draghicioiu-site). The ANRE web comparator lists offers; it does not keep the user's contract, compute yearly savings against it, explain the price structure, keep a price history or send alerts.
- Intended users: households in Romania who pay electricity or gas bills and want to know whether switching supplier is worth it.
The app is informational and not affiliated with ANRE or any supplier.

ro.name: Utilități – Comparator
ro.subtitle: Economia la curent și gaz
ro.promotionalText: Adaugă ce plătești acum la curent și la gaz și vezi pe loc cât economisești pe an cu cea mai ieftină ofertă ANRE din zona ta. Primești alertă când apare una nouă.
ro.description:
Plătești prea mult la curent sau la gaz? Spune-ne ce plătești acum și îți arătăm, în lei pe an, cât economisești dacă schimbi furnizorul.

CÂT ECONOMISEȘTI, NU DOAR CINE E MAI IEFTIN
• Adaugi contractul actual: alegi oferta din lista ANRE sau scrii prețul de pe factură
• Vezi economia pe an pentru fiecare ofertă din zona ta, față de ce plătești acum
• Pentru fiecare locuință ai consumul și contractele ei

PREȚUL EXPLICAT
• Din ce e format prețul fiecărei oferte: energie, distribuție, transport, taxe, TVA
• Ce parte diferă între furnizori și ce parte e reglementată de ANRE
• Factura estimată lună de lună: la gaz, cu iernile mai scumpe
• Condițiile contractului, oferta-tip oficială în PDF și pașii pentru schimbarea furnizorului

LA ADRESA TA
• Operatorul rețelei de curent și al rețelei de gaz din localitatea ta
• La gaz, prețul calculat cu tariful de distribuție al localității tale

ISTORIC ȘI ALERTE
• Graficul celui mai mic preț din zona ta, zi de zi, comparat cu contractul tău
• Alertă pe telefon când apare o ofertă care te costă mai puțin decât contractul actual

MAI MULTE LOCUINȚE
Acasă, la părinți, casa de vacanță: fiecare cu adresa, consumul și contractele ei.

DATE OFICIALE, LA ZI
Ofertele de curent și gaz sunt preluate în fiecare dimineață din comparatorul oficial ANRE (posf.ro). Prețurile sunt finale: energie, distribuție, transport, taxe și TVA incluse. Ai și cele mai ieftine abonamente de internet, TV și mobil.

SIMPLU ȘI DISCRET
• Fără cont, fără reclame, fără cumpărături în aplicație
• Locuințele, consumul și contractele rămân doar pe telefonul tău

Aplicația are rol informativ și nu este afiliată ANRE sau vreunui furnizor. Verifică întotdeauna condițiile ofertei la furnizor înainte de a semna.

en-US.name: Utilități – Comparator
en-US.subtitle: Romanian energy bill savings
en-US.promotionalText: Add what you pay for electricity and gas in Romania and see your yearly saving with the cheapest official ANRE offer in your area. Get alerted when a cheaper one appears.
en-US.description:
Paying too much for electricity or gas in Romania? Tell the app what you pay now and it shows, in lei per year, how much you save by switching supplier.

HOW MUCH YOU SAVE, NOT JUST WHO IS CHEAPEST
• Add your current contract: pick your offer from the ANRE list or type the price from your bill
• See the yearly saving of every offer in your area compared with what you pay today
• Each home keeps its own consumption and contracts

THE PRICE EXPLAINED
• What every offer's price is made of: energy, distribution, transport, taxes, VAT
• Which part differs between suppliers and which part is regulated by ANRE
• The estimated bill month by month, with the colder months costing more for gas
• Contract terms, the official offer PDF and the steps to switch supplier

AT YOUR ADDRESS
• The electricity and gas network operator for your locality
• Gas prices calculated with your locality's distribution tariff

HISTORY AND ALERTS
• A chart of the cheapest price in your area, day by day, against your contract
• A notification when an offer appears that costs less than your current contract

SEVERAL HOMES
Home, parents, holiday house: each with its own address, consumption and contracts.

OFFICIAL, UP-TO-DATE DATA
Electricity and gas offers are refreshed every morning from the official price comparator of the Romanian Energy Regulatory Authority (ANRE, posf.ro). Prices are final: energy, distribution, transport, taxes and VAT included. Internet, TV and mobile plans are included too.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no in-app purchases
• Your homes, consumption and contracts stay on your phone

The app is informational and is not affiliated with ANRE or any supplier. Always check the offer terms with the supplier before signing.
